asset.name: Month-end close started
asset.description: Sent to the finance team when the close starts, listing the tasks issued.
asset.subject: Month-end close {{period}} ({{entity}}) has started
asset.html_body:
The {{period}} close has started

Hi team,

The {{period}} close for {{entity}} is open in the ERP ({{close_id}}). {{task_count}} close tasks were issued; the deadline is {{close_deadline}}.

Tasks: {{=JOIN(PLUCK(close_tasks, "task_code"), ", ")}}

Complete each task in UserTasks with the evidence link. Progress is recorded in the Close log.

Sent by the month-end close workflow
